title: Listening Drill — Public speaking club — Trial review
description: Conversation about a trial. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: Public speaking club — Trial review
sections.transcript:
HOST: You ran two introductory sessions on public speaking club last week. What happened in the first one?

GUEST: On the first run, several people reported a problem with rushed speech. At first we wondered whether it was a problem with the instructions. A closer inspection revealed the fault: missing timer.

HOST: What changed when you ran the session again?

GUEST: On each trial, we now keep a record of speaking pace so changes can be compared. For the second trial we let everyone borrow cue cards instead of bringing their own. That helped us keep the equipment as consistent as possible.

HOST: What should people who attended do now?

GUEST: Send any suggestions directly to the club chair before the next group arrives. The next group comes on Saturday, so we have time to compare notes beforehand.
